assets.prompt: Use case: game sprite asset. Make a production 2D anime beat-em-up sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 separate full-body poses. Reference image is character identity/style only: use ONLY the rightmost character Gota, the gang boss. Male adult, muscular tall but slimmer than Brute, huge black pompadour, stern visible eyes (REMOVE sunglasses), cheek scar, long open black Japanese school delinquent coat with gold buttons, dark burgundy shirt, red waist sash, black trousers and black leather shoes. Consistent clean dark ink outline, restrained 3-tone cel shading matching the reference art. All poses face RIGHT in profile/three-quarter side view. Fixed camera, fixed proportions and head size, no perspective changes, uniform cell grid, generous blank gutters, each complete body isolated. Genuine transparent background, no shadow, no text, no guides or labels. Row 1: guard stance, subtle breathing guard, recoiling from a hit, stagger leaning backward. Row 2: jab anticipation fist drawn back, straight punch fully extended right, punch follow-through, recovery guard. Row 3: airborne knockback curled, airborne falling backward, landing on side, lying flat facing right. Row 4: lying on side, pushing up on one hand, kneeling with one knee up, standing back into guard. Do not crop extremities, no weapons. This is an animation atlas, not a scene.
